implementation: Validate each causal probability row and complete V column once. Metadata lives in the already consumed QK score slab until replay completes; probabilities, scales, admission bounds and candidate buffers remain disjoint. No device allocation is added. Tiny slabs retain the original replay.

Each selected cell retains the original candidate identity, K16 finish/FP32 conversion endpoints, K32 alpha multiplication and final reciprocal. Eligible rows use exact scalar BF16 products followed by the canonical integer alignment and normalization; all other rows and declined groups use original integer arithmetic.

One-thread and four-thread implementations are exposed to the component harness through QRT_ATTENTION_REPLAY_PREVALIDATED_FLOAT_PV=1|4. The product provider passes the default0 and has no environment dispatch for this experiment.
conclusions: All348 generated native comparisons pass:116 inputs each for original,1-thread and4-thread replay. These cover51904512 output positions with raw output/accumulator/denominator equality, CPU metadata comparison, input immutability, unique candidates and redzones. Cases include empty,dense,sparse selections, nonzero starts, tails, signed zero, subnormal and eligibility-boundary values.

All three real q7169 variants preserve29364224 original GB10 BF16 cells,2198673 selected cells and all four previously qualified output/accumulator/denominator file hashes. Scalar QK1,direct PV1,final PV bound1,transposed V1 and query batch128 are common.

Completed query plus V preparation is 645.9263/689.9965/638.8247 ms for original/1-thread/4-thread in these single component observations. The1-thread version is slower;4-thread improves by only7.1016 ms. This provides no evidence for a seconds-scale product gain. Keep the product PV dispatcher unchanged and investigate broader dense projection correction, currently7359.256 ms in the qualified q8192 state8 run.

Full make check passes364 Python tests with2 skipped,47 Rust tests,C smoke,clippy and public hygiene. Host tests execute the actual launch paths, failure propagation, metadata capacity guards and tiny-slab fallback. An initial test expectation omitted the existing1024-block cap; its corrected assertion passes without a runtime change.
limitations: Component correctness and timing do not constitute a full model token loop or product performance acceptance. No q8192 product run was conducted for this PV candidate.
Single observations do not establish repeatability. Common uploads, allocation and safety-only checks lie outside the component query clock; complete product callback clocks remain authoritative.
Current qualified product remains FLA2ee6215 state8 at39620.1231 ms q8192 callback TTFT. Long-context, prefix checkpoint, package, HTTP, soak and retained-performance gates remain open.
